title: Preserve trace by using a state-independent CPTP branch
statement: For Phi=alpha B_EB+(1-alpha)Cwith honest CPTP branches, the actual-prior universal recovered channel is alpha E+(1-alpha)D. F=alpha sum_k(1-alpha)^k D^k E is an EB CPTP map and id-F=(id-(1-alpha)D)^-1(id-Psi), giving average trace error<=sqrt(delta)/alpha. Support extension of recovery is mandatory. Unital self-compatible qubits supplyalpha>=1-1/sqrt2, but arbitrary nonunital channels need not.

assumptions: All-reference extensions require the stated PRODUCT ensemble barycenter, allowing correlated individual letters; EB acts on A only. They do not cover every correlated barycenter or tensorize over many noisy qubits. Actual prior and contraction/minorization data are supplied, not learned. A TNI event with positive effect is not the constant-weight CPTP branch: the tempting left resolvent can increase trace. The separate finite-depth salvage is valid with a weaker error.
